<description>
This PR speeds up wallet fast-rescan by executing the filter checks in parallel while ensuring that the filters are updated properly so that no output scripts are missed.  Benchmarks, outlined below, show considerable improvement that slows down around `8` threads.

### Prerequisite PRs
- [x] https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34667 - modify the fast-rescan test to ensure that it fails when the filter is not updated properly.
- [x] https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34681 - refactor `CWallet::ScanForWalletTransactions` to prepare for the work in this PR.

### Benchmarks
#### Prepare
- Please tune your system with `pyperf system tune`.
- Enable block filters by setting `blockfilterindex=1` in your bitcoin.conf file and sync your node to the tip.
- Parallel fast-rescan will not be used if `chain.isInitialBlockDownload()` is `true`. Ensure your node is synced before shutting down and running the mainnet benchmark commands.

Using the following command on mainnet with a wallet with no scripts and hyperfine version `1.20.0`:
- On master
```
hyperfine --show-output --export-markdown master.md --export-json master.json  \
--sort command \
--runs 3 \
--prepare 'cmake --build build -j 20 && build/bin/bitcoind -blockfilterindex=1 -networkactive=0 && sleep 10 && build/bin/bitcoin-cli loadwalllet <wallet-name>' \
--conclude 'build/bin/bitcoin-cli stop && sleep 10' \
'build/bin/bitcoin-cli rescanblockchain 700000 900000'
```

- On this PR:
```
hyperfine --show-output --export-markdown results.md --export-json results.json  \
--sort command \
--runs 3 \
-L num_threads 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,16 \
--prepare 'cmake --build build -j 20 && build/bin/bitcoind -blockfilterindex=1 -networkactive=0 -walletpar={num_threads} && sleep 10 && build/bin/bitcoin-cli loadwalllet <wallet-name>' \
--conclude 'build/bin/bitcoin-cli stop && sleep 10' \
'build/bin/bitcoin-cli rescanblockchain 700000 900000'
```

<commits>
fdb49a2b72 wallet/scan: check block is active under cs_wallet before syncing

Checking inActiveChain before reading the block left a window where the
block could be disconnected and its blockDisconnected notification
handled before its transactions were synced as confirmed. Checking with
cs_wallet held closes it, since that notification needs cs_wallet.

c1b97000bc wallet/scan: combine block iteration and filtering in NextBlocksSerial

Move the filtering in ShouldFetchBlock into NextBlocksSerial, which
returns the blocks to scan, and keep per-scan state in a ScanContext.
No behaviour change; this prepares for parallel filter checks.

15fa337407 wallet: add -walletpar option

Number of threads for wallet operations, to be used by parallel fast
rescan. As for -par, the calling thread counts towards it, 0
auto-detects, a negative value leaves that many cores free, and at most
MAX_WALLETPAR (15) dedicated threads are used.

5441a57e59 wallet/scan: check block filters in parallel

With -walletpar > 1, fast rescan checks block filters on a thread pool.
Blocks are read in windows, checked in tasks of BLOCKS_PER_FILTER_TASK blocks
queued ahead of delivery, and delivered in block order, so workers keep
checking while the scan thread scans matched blocks.

On a keypool top-up, in-flight checks are drained and undelivered
NO_MATCH verdicts are re-checked against only the new scripts. Read-ahead
is wasted work then, so the window shrinks on every top-up and grows
while there are none.

ca3136699b wallet: don't rescan in parallel during IBD

Parallel filter checks would compete with block validation for cores.

86a78c189e wallet/tests: exercise parallel fast rescan

Run the filter-dependent scan tests with -walletpar 1 and 4, and check
that the wallet loading rescan takes the parallel path.

db2d769ff2 test: cover serial and parallel fast rescan in wallet_fast_rescan

Parallel fast rescan is now the default, so pin the existing fast
rescans to -walletpar=1 and add the same rescans with -walletpar=4.
</commits>
